Number-Conversion Macros / Format Conversions

FixedToFloat

You can use the FixedToFloat macro to convert a Fixed number to a floating-point number. 
#define FixedToFloat(a) ((float)(a) / fixed1)
a
A Fixed number to be converted to a floating-point number.
macro result
A floating-point number having the same value as the Fixed number.
